name: Browser read DOM
description: Reads the rendered DOM of the visible in-app browser as text, HTML, or a role/name accessibility snapshot, stores the full content as an artifact, and returns a truncated summary plus reference.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 读取用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器已渲染的 DOM（文本、HTML，或 role/name 角色快照），可按 CSS 选择器限定范围；完整内容以 artifact 落盘，仅返回截断摘要与引用。
localizedDescription.en-US: Reads the rendered DOM of the visible in-app browser as text, HTML, or a role/name accessibility snapshot, stores the full content as an artifact, and returns a truncated summary plus reference.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope the read to a subtree (first match).

format.description: text, html, or roles (accessibility snapshot of role/name/selector). Defaults to text.
